title: Close sparse FieldMatrix SpMV and SpMM gaps
description:
Define and close sparse FieldMatrix SpMV/SpMM performance gaps.

## Background

Sparse PPC work produced scaffolds and negative/no-go evidence, but sparse SOTA parity needs a target corpus, comparable references, and hardware-counter-driven layout work.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] A sparse benchmark corpus and reference set are defined for finite-field SpMV/SpMM.
- [hard] CPU sparse target rows are within 1.5x of accepted references where feasible.
- [hard] Any remaining sparse gap has an explicit CPU no-go analysis and, if needed, a user-approved GPU follow-up dependency.
